comments.content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (43c9a6c). exec_ref_value (thermite-tv/src/exec_encode.rs) — the independent BOUNDED-value (u64/usize/bool, never nat-coerced) exec-position reference encoder + lower_exec_expr (thermite-lower, the production per-expr exec lowering; the exec Ctx IS reachable for a standalone expr). Critic NO DIVERGENCE: generalizes (14 new exec exprs faithful — cast targets/nested arith/shifts/bitops/chained casts/RHS-cast-<), bounded-value sound both directions (overflow/wrap/truncation infidelity caught; no false positive — faithful arith's overflow obligation is the honest L1 one), unilateral misdispatch caught, honest Unsupported for signed/u128/method (out of scope). Independence intact.
